description: A worked example of the corpus format: one plain Messages turn, no tools, no triggers.
origin_note: Hand-written, not captured. It exists so the format has an example a reviewer can read in one screen, and so the loader and the lint have something real to run over before T-C1 lands the first evidence. It is NOT evidence and must never be read as such -- `captured_only()` excludes it by construction. Delete it once the captured corpus is large enough that the format speaks for itself.
